# agy-NOV

> The 100% Native Modular Super-Workbench for Google Antigravity 2.0 (v1.0.1, full macOS / Windows / Linux native cross-platform compatibility with 3-OS × Node 20/22 CI) — 13 independently toggleable superpowers organized across a **4+1 Functional Domain IA** (`core` / `pipeline` / `toolbox` / `connectivity` + L0 Workflow Hub & `Cmd/Ctrl+K` palette) inside one official native MCP App plugin (12 strictly local offline modules + 1 opt-in remote module that stays inert by default), featuring **Ops 3.0** (read-only static security audit `securityFindings` + `securityScore` 0–100 across `prompt-injection`/`broad-command-allow`/`risky-hook`/`mcp-unsafe-env` with zero secret echo, cross-client `.claude/`/`.cursor/rules/`/`.codex/` SHA-256 deduplication & slimming preview `migrationPreview`, plus 8-language **Tool-Slot Idle Advisor** in SettingsHub S4), **Mem 3.0** (memory hygiene with `verified`/`normal`/`tentative` confidence tiers, `manual`/`spec_archive`/`auto_capture` provenance, `ttlDays` 1–365 expiration, `Stop`-hook `tentative` + 14d TTL auto-capture, auto-filtering expired tentative memories on `SessionStart` L1 & default `mem_recall`, and `MemPanel` batch Verify / Refresh TTL +30d / double-confirm Prune bar), **Customizable 9-Segment CLI `statusLine`** (`--segments=<csv>` / `AGY_NOV_STATUSLINE_SEGMENTS`) & **Preview-Then-Confirm `.agy-nov.json` Scaffold** (`recommend --export-preset [--confirm] [--force]`), an end-to-end **Engineering Pipeline Loop (`Spec → Worktree → Two-Stage Review → Verify → Mem`)**, **One-Click Clean Fork** anti-context-rot continuation, **5 official on-demand Skills** (`agy-nov` + `/nov-spec`, `/nov-debug`, `/nov-review`, `/nov-handoff`), **2 independent read-only specialist subagents** (`nov-blind-reviewer`, `nov-security-auditor`, zero default resident `rules/AGENTS.md` bloat), official MCP Apps **`file` native custom file viewer** (`app_nov_file_viewer`, hidden from models), **Remote 2.5** structured risk approval cards, **Turbo 3.0**, **Guard 2.5**, **Spec 2.0**, adaptive `< 720px` / `>= 720px` navigation, 4-tier **Settings Hub** (S1–S4), **5 official Lifecycle Hooks** (incl. zero-token `PreInvocation` visual receipts), dual-star read-only `feed-snapshot.json` contract (`0600` atomic, `< 64 KiB`, O(n) redacted), 100% full-component 8-language UI (**24 UI components**, `~1.23 MiB`, measured `1,261.2 KB`), **9 CLI commands** (`doctor` verifying all **15** core plugin assets), Zero ASAR, Zero CDP, dynamic tool registration (zero token & tool-slot tax when off, strictly **47** canonical model tools across `v0.4`→`v1.0.1`), and 5 presets.

## Core Facts

- Repository: https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV
- License: MIT (independent open-source project; unaffiliated with Google LLC)
- Version: 1.0.1
- Supported Platforms: macOS / Windows / Linux (full native cross-platform compatibility, verified by GitHub Actions 3-OS `ubuntu-latest` / `windows-latest` / `macos-latest` × Node 20/22 CI matrix)
- Runtime requirements: Node.js >= 20.0.0, Google Antigravity 2.0 (Desktop / CLI / IDE)
- Protocol & Entrypoints: 100% official native protocols — MCP Apps (`SEP-1865`, `ui://agy-nov/app.html`, `aux_pane` + `global` + official `com.google.antigravity/ui` `file` entrypoint `app_nov_file_viewer`), 5 Antigravity Lifecycle Hooks (`SessionStart`, `PreToolUse` incl. `overwrite` & `force_ask`, `PostToolUse`, `PreInvocation`, `Stop`), **5 official on-demand Skills** (`skills/agy-nov/SKILL.md` + `/nov-spec`, `/nov-debug`, `/nov-review`, `/nov-handoff`), **2 read-only specialist subagents** (`agents/nov-blind-reviewer.md`, `agents/nov-security-auditor.md`, zero default resident `rules/AGENTS.md` bloat), dual-star `feed-snapshot.json` file contract, optional `.agy-nov.json` team preset & `.worktreeinclude` allowlist, and **9-command CLI** (`statusline --segments`, `recommend --export-preset`, `compact-run`, 15-asset `doctor`, etc.); Zero ASAR, Zero CDP
- Runtime Artifacts: 1 resident MCP server (`dist/server.cjs`), 1 unified 5-hook lifecycle dispatcher (`dist/hook.cjs` with async bounded stdin streaming), 1 single-file 100% 8-language dark/light UI (`dist/ui/app.html`, `~1.23 MiB` — measured `1,261.2 KB`, well below the 1.5 MiB target and 10 MiB limit; covering all **24 UI components** across 8 locales), 1 CLI (`dist/cli.cjs`, **9 commands**, `doctor` checking all **15** core assets), **5 official Skills** (`skills/{agy-nov,nov-spec,nov-debug,nov-review,nov-handoff}/SKILL.md`), and **2 read-only specialist subagents** (`agents/{nov-blind-reviewer,nov-security-auditor}.md`)
- Automated Test Coverage: **88 test suites / 245 tests** (including `test/v101-cross-platform.test.ts` and 3 v1.0.0 suites: `test/v10-ops-security-dedup.test.ts`, `test/v10-mem-hygiene-ttl.test.ts`, `test/v10-cli-statusline-preset.test.ts`, executed via cross-platform `scripts/run-tests.mjs` on macOS, Windows, and Linux)
- Always-On Entry Tools (2 Model Tools): `nov_open` (open workbench or jump directly to `hub`, `settings`, backward-compatible `modules`, or any of the 13 modules), `nov_status` (inspect enabled modules, preset, UI locale, exact model tool count, and network isolation state). All Hub, Settings Hub (incl. S4 Tool-Slot Idle Advisor), Context Pack, Dep Inspect, Turn Rewind, Turbo preference, Clean Fork (`app_xray_build_clean_fork_pack`), `.worktreeinclude` preview (`app_worktree_preview_include`), PR delivery evidence (`app_verify_pr_summary`), Mem 3.0 hygiene controls (`app_mem_get_hygiene_summary`, `app_mem_batch_hygiene`), and native `file` viewer (`app_nov_file_viewer`) actions are strictly App-only (`visibility: ['app']`) with zero model-context overhead.
- Dynamic Token & 100-Tool Budget Efficiency + Live `config.json` Hot-Sync & Dual-Star `feed-snapshot.json`: Disabled modules call `RegisteredTool.disable()` with delta visibility tracking and emit `tools/list_changed` only for modules whose state changed (0 model schema token overhead and 0 tool slots consumed against Antigravity's 100-tool hard limit when off); mutating `app_*` tools (including `app_mem_batch_hygiene`) disable alongside model tools; `dist/hook.cjs` reads `config.json` read-only and returns `{}` in O(1); a lightweight `.unref()` read-only `statSync` poller plus `nov_open`/`nov_status`/`nov_app_get_config` sync automatically picks up external atomic `config.json` updates from `agy-Sag`'s native Settings control panel or `agy-nov` CLI while refreshing `<dataDir>/feed-snapshot.json` (`0600` atomic, `< 64 KiB`, O(n) redacted, zero mkdir/writes when `dataDir` is absent) with zero CDP and zero extra ports.

## Presets and Exact Model Tool Counts

Total exposed model tools = 2 always-on entry tools (`nov_open`, `nov_status`) + sum of enabled module tools (maximum **47** across all 13 modules; all 47 canonical model tool names remain strictly unchanged from `v0.4` through `v1.0.1` with +0 tool-slot inflation):

- `minimal` (1 module, 6 tools, 100% offline): `guard` (4)
- `core` [default] (3 modules, 12 tools, 100% offline): `review` (2), `guard` (4), `xray` (4)
- `power` (9 modules, 32 tools, 100% offline): `review` (2), `guard` (4), `xray` (4), `turbo` (3), `radar` (2), `verify` (4), `worktree` (4), `spec` (4), `ops` (3)
- `local-all` (12 offline modules, 43 tools, 100% offline): `review` (2), `guard` (4), `xray` (4), `turbo` (3), `radar` (2), `verify` (4), `worktree` (4), `spec` (4), `studio` (4), `canvas` (4), `mem` (3), `ops` (3)
- `full` (all 13 modules, 47 tools, opt-in network): all 12 offline modules plus `remote` (4)

## Official On-Demand Playbooks, Read-Only Subagents & Native `file` Viewer (0 Model Tool Slots)

- **5 Official On-Demand Skills (`skills/*/SKILL.md`):** Entry skill `agy-nov` plus 4 slash playbooks — `/nov-spec` (Spec-first & Brownfield Delta workflow), `/nov-debug` (4-step root-cause debugging), `/nov-review` (two-stage Spec + diff review), and `/nov-handoff` (anti-context-rot handoff & Clean Fork) — occupying 0 MCP tool slots and 0 default resident `rules/AGENTS.md` context tokens.
- **2 Official Read-Only Specialist Subagents (`agents/*.md`, `subagent: true, mainAgent: false`):** `nov-blind-reviewer` (`agents/nov-blind-reviewer.md`, zero-history-bias two-stage reviewer returning `file:line` findings & `PASS`/`CHANGES_REQUESTED`) and `nov-security-auditor` (`agents/nov-security-auditor.md`, independent OWASP & local-agent red-team auditor returning `Critical`/`High`/`Medium`/`Low` findings); both declare strictly read-only tools (`read_file`, `grep_search`, `find_by_name`, `list_dir`).
- **MCP Apps `file` Native Custom File Viewer (`app_nov_file_viewer`):** Registers the official `com.google.antigravity/ui` `file` entrypoint for `.sqlite`, `.sqlite3`, `.db`, `.csv`, `.tsv`, `.svg`, `.openapi.yaml`, and `.openapi.yml` (`visibility: ['app']`, completely hidden from models, 0 tool tax, strict `realpath` boundary, SVG XSS sanitization, safe `antigravity-file://` opaque URI fallback), remaining available for read-only previews even when `studio` and `canvas` are toggled off.

## 13 Toggleable Native Modules Across 4+1 Functional Domains

The **+1 Workflow Hub** (`HubPanel`) aggregates a 6-node pipeline status strip, prioritized alert cards, and One-Click Clean Fork at L0, paired with `< 720px` (4-control compact header + grouped dropdown) / `>= 720px` (`204px` grouped left rail) adaptive navigation, `Cmd/Ctrl+K` quick jump, and a 4-tier **Settings Hub** (`SettingsHub`, S1–S4, with 6 S3 strategy drawers & S4 8-language **Tool-Slot Idle Advisor**).

### Tier 1: 12 Local Offline Native Modules (100% Offline, Zero ASAR, Zero CDP)

- `review` (domain: `core`, default ON, 2 tools, hooks: `PostToolUse`, `Stop`): Two-stage PR-grade Git diff viewer featuring one-click switching across registered Worktree branches, automatic read-only active Spec acceptance checklist (**Stage 1** Spec compliance + **Stage 2** code quality `file:line` annotations), zero-dependency pure-React syntax highlighting (zero `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`), ignore-whitespace (`-w`) toggle, deterministic zero-ReDoS line-level risk pre-annotations (1-click convert to annotation), line comments, and `file:line` fix prompts (`review_open`, `review_get_summary`)
- `guard` (domain: `core`, default ON, 4 tools, hooks: `PreToolUse`, `PreInvocation`): **Guard 2.5** `.env`/SSH/secret firewall, destructive command guard, session & turn-grouped (`turnKey`) zero-Git pre-edit file snapshots (reverting multi-edit files back to **before their first edit** in that turn) with multi-file turn diff preview (`app_guard_get_turn_diff`), All-or-Nothing boundary/symlink preflight, `pre-rewind` backup, and inline double-confirm 1-click full-turn rollback (`app_guard_restore_turn`); 3 protocol-level `permissionMode` tiers (`readonly-audit` hard-denies all writes & commands, `balanced-dev` default balanced defense, `strict-gate` enforces official `PreToolUse` `force_ask` on all writes & commands while critical rules remain hard `deny`), wired into `GuardPanel` and Settings Hub S3; plus zero-token `PreInvocation` visual receipt on recent denies (`guard_status`, `guard_list_snapshots`, `guard_create_checkpoint`, `guard_scan_secrets`)
- `xray` (domain: `core`, default ON, 4 tools, hooks: `PostToolUse`, `Stop`): Context X-Ray 2.0 + **One-Click Clean Fork** (`app_xray_build_clean_fork_pack` in `XrayPanel` & `HubPanel`, zero model-tool tax, aggregating redacted Handoff + active Spec unblocked `ready` tasks + Mem core code anchors within a `<= 12 KB` linear-redacted budget and launching a clean same-project background session via `app.sendMessage({ _meta: { "com.google.antigravity/message": { target: "new" } } })`, gracefully falling back to context-pill attachment or copy on `global` surfaces), built-in offline USD reference pricing (with strictly read-only `pricing-overrides.json`, `<= 1 MiB`), 14-day daily spend trends, 5-hour rolling burn-rate alerts, cached vs. fresh token breakdown, Swarm subagent lineage (`swarmLineage`), multi-model cost breakdown (`modelBreakdown`), HTTP 429 retry alerts (`retrySignals`), live file activity, EN+CJK BM25 cross-session search, and `xray_export_brief` supporting `format: 'brief' | 'handoff' | 'otlp' | 'csv'` with formula-injection neutralization (`xray_analyze_context`, `xray_get_file_activity`, `xray_search_sessions`, `xray_export_brief`)
- `spec` (domain: `pipeline`, default OFF, 4 tools, hooks: `SessionStart`, `PreToolUse`, `PreInvocation`): **Spec 2.0** Plannotator-grade inline review bench + `Spec -> Plan -> Task DAG` feeding Stage 1 Review compliance checklists and Clean Fork `ready` tasks, supporting `full` / Brownfield `delta` (`ADDED`/`MODIFIED`/`REMOVED`) modes, automatic revision numbers with latest 8 snapshots, zero-dependency pure-TS line-level LCS diff (`> 600` lines linear fallback), inline `Comment`/`Strike`/`Replace` annotations with 1-click structured bounce-back to agent, 1-click archive into `mem` (auto `<private>` stripping & secret redaction), Kahn topological cycle detection, dependency-gated task advancement, pure read-only `SessionStart` next-ready-task recall, `PreToolUse` draft write lock (`enforcePlanBeforeWrite`), `requireUiApproval`, and zero-token `PreInvocation` lock receipt (`spec_get_state`, `spec_create_or_update`, `spec_approve`, `spec_update_task`)
- `worktree` (domain: `pipeline`, default OFF, 4 tools, hooks: none): Safe parallel Git worktree orchestrator confined to `.agy-worktrees/` with read-only allowlisted **`.worktreeinclude`** (`app_worktree_preview_include` preview + `applyInclude` default ON, rejecting `.env`/private keys/symlinks/out-of-bounds paths into `skippedSensitive` with zero auto-RCE scripts), `carryUncommitted` transfer, branch diff summaries, one-click card jump to `Review` & `Verify`, `extensions.worktreeConfig` hazard detection, and safe orphan/merged cleanup (`worktree_list`, `worktree_create`, `worktree_diff_summary`, `worktree_cleanup`)
- `verify` (domain: `pipeline`, default OFF, 4 tools, hooks: `PostToolUse`, `Stop`): Stop-hook verification gate supporting targeted allowlisted checks inside registered Worktrees (`worktreePath`), App-only redacted paste-ready PR delivery evidence summary (`app_verify_pr_summary`), zero-write project stack auto-detection (`package.json` pnpm/yarn/bun/npm, `pyproject.toml`/`pytest.ini`, `Cargo.toml`, `go.mod`) validated against the shell-free 17-binary allowlist, 0-byte write blocking, `continuation_active` awareness, anti-loop `maxConsecutiveBlocks` guardrails, and a redacted evidence chain (`verify_get_policy`, `verify_set_policy`, `verify_run_checks`, `verify_get_evidence`)
- `turbo` (domain: `pipeline`, default OFF, 3 tools, hooks: `SessionStart`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`): **Turbo 3.0** featuring opt-in **Auto-RTK** transparent `PreToolUse.overwrite` proxy (`autoRtk: false` by default; rewrites allowlisted shell-free test/build/read-only Git commands into `agy-nov compact-run --payload=<base64url>`, preserving non-zero exit codes, full error stacks & `0600` redacted `last-raw.log`, plus `PostToolUse` noisy-command hotspot discovery surfaced in `TurboPanel` and Settings Hub S3), **Offline Locked Dep Contracts** (`turbo_read_outline` `depPackage` & `app_turbo_inspect_dep` parsing local `node_modules/.d.ts` incl. barrel re-exports, Python `.venv/.pyi`, Go `go.mod`, Rust `Cargo.lock` with `realpath` containment), **Lightweight Cross-File Symbol References** (`turbo_batch_search` `mode: "references"` strictly O(n) `definitions`/`imports`/`usages`, zero resident LSP), **Redacted Context Pack** (`app_turbo_build_context_pack` supporting scope/safe globs/`fromGitDiff` + token caps `256`–`32,000` + O(n) redaction), multi-indent nested symbol outlines, RTK smart compression presets (`auto`, `test`, `build`, `git`, `generic`) with in-memory LRU (24), UTF-8 code-point-safe `<= 8.8 KB` (`8,800 B`) anti-spill guardrails across all 3 model tools, and an in-memory cumulative token & USD savings Gain Dashboard (`$2.50/1M` baseline, `app_turbo_get_gain`) (`turbo_batch_search`, `turbo_read_outline`, `turbo_compact_output`)
- `mem` (domain: `pipeline`, default OFF, 3 tools, hooks: `SessionStart`, `PreInvocation`, `Stop`): **Mem 3.0** SHA-256 code-anchored architectural memory feeding Clean Fork core anchors, adding source **confidence tiers** (`verified` / `normal` / `tentative`), provenance (`manual` / `spec_archive` / `auto_capture`), and optional TTL expiration (`ttlDays` 1–365 / `expiresAt`); `Stop`-hook auto-captures default to `tentative` + `14`-day TTL to stop dirty memories from polluting future sessions; `SessionStart` **L1 Index** (`<= 1,200` chars) and default 3-layer progressive `mem_recall` (`mode: "index" | "timeline" | "detail"`, `ids[]`, `window`) auto-exclude expired unpinned `tentative` memories (`includeExpired: true` recovers them; `pinned` never expires); `MemPanel` adds hygiene overview capsule filters, confidence/TTL badges, multi-select, and batch **Verify / Refresh TTL (+30d) / Prune (inline double confirmation)** (`app_mem_get_hygiene_summary` read-only + `app_mem_batch_hygiene` synced with module switch), alongside linear O(n) `<private>...</private>` tag stripping, stale drift detection, and zero-token `PreInvocation` drift receipt (`mem_remember`, `mem_recall`, `mem_forget`)
- `radar` (domain: `toolbox`, default OFF, 2 tools, hooks: `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `Stop`): Multi-session & parent/child Swarm subagent attention board featuring an **approval-first 4-lane Kanban view** (`Awaiting Approval` pinned first → `Running` → `Stalled / Error` → `Completed`) with one-click card jump into `Review`, orphan subagent alerts, `status-capsule.json` compact export, unread counters, and optional completion chime (`radar_get_board`, `radar_ack_session`)
- `studio` (domain: `toolbox`, default OFF, 4 tools, hooks: none): On-demand local workbench offering read-only SQLite + CSV/TSV/JSON/NDJSON inspection, zero-binary pure-Node offline DOCX/XLSX/PDF/Markdown/HTML/SVG/YAML/XML slicing with ZIP-bomb guards, zero-dependency OpenAPI 2.0/3.x YAML & JSON parser (YAML anchor-bomb & prototype-pollution safe) generating clickable endpoint collections that auto-fill the strict loopback-only anti-SSRF HTTP probe (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `[::1]`) — toggle off when idle for zero tool-budget overhead while `app_nov_file_viewer` stays available for read-only native file previews (`studio_list_sources`, `studio_inspect_data`, `studio_inspect_document`, `studio_http_probe`)
- `canvas` (domain: `toolbox`, default OFF, 4 tools, hooks: none): Isolated sandbox preview for HTML, SVG, slides, Markdown & images with numbered visual pin annotations (`canvas_publish_artifact`, `canvas_open_file`, `canvas_get_feedback`, `canvas_resolve_annotations`)
- `ops` (domain: `toolbox`, default OFF, 3 tools, hooks: none): **Ops 3.0** parameterized `{{var}}` Prompt Vault plus read-only **Static Security Audit** (`securityFindings` + `securityScore` 0–100, O(n), symlink-refusing, `<= 256 KiB` / 80 files max, detecting `prompt-injection`, `broad-command-allow`, `risky-hook`, and `mcp-unsafe-env` with zero secret echo and zero false positives on compliant repos), read-only **Cross-Client Deduplication & Slimming Preview** (`migrationPreview` for `.claude/` / `.cursor/rules/` / `.codex/` computing normalized line & paragraph SHA-256 duplicate ratios and reclaimable bytes/tokens without mutating files), 24KB (`24576 B`) single-file / `20,000` aggregate token rule-bloat guard (false 429 guard), 100-tool MCP hard-limit budget meter paired with SettingsHub S4 **Tool-Slot Idle Advisor**, static MCP config health (`mcpHealthFindings`), Antigravity `#233` unexpanded `${ENV_VAR}` traps, `#1937` duplicate plugin / duplicate MCP server warnings, skills, and local storage (`ops_list_prompts`, `ops_render_prompt`, `ops_audit_workspace`)

### Tier 2: 1 Strictly Opt-In Remote Module (OFF by Default)

- `remote` (domain: `connectivity`, default OFF, 4 tools: `remote_status`, `remote_send_alert`, `remote_list_conversations`, `remote_dispatch_task`, hooks: `PreToolUse`, `Stop`, opt-in network): **Remote 2.5** featuring upgraded Mobile PWA & IM structured risk approval cards (`HIGH`/`MED`/`LOW` risk badge, affected file count, redacted command summary, latest read-only `Verify` status, rendered strictly with pure DOM APIs and zero `innerHTML`), tap-to-expand read-only redacted conversation live stream (`GET /api/conversations/:id/stream`, zero file writes / zero remote shell), on-demand read-only `tailscale` / `cloudflared` detection & copyable safe tunnel command guide (shell-free `execFile`, zero automatic tunnel launch), plus Telegram/Feishu/DingTalk/WeCom/Slack/Discord alerts, risky-command approvals, and task dispatch

## 4+1 IA, 4-Tier Settings Hub, Dual-Star Feed, Team Preset & 100% 8-Language UI

- **4+1 IA & Adaptive Navigation:** L0 **Hub** (6-node pipeline bar + alert cards + One-Click Clean Fork) + 4 functional domains (`core`, `pipeline`, `toolbox`, `connectivity`), switching automatically between `< 720px` narrow sidebar (4-control compact header + grouped dropdown) and `>= 720px` full-width pane (`204px` grouped left rail), plus `Cmd/Ctrl+K` quick jump.
- **4-Tier Settings Hub:** S1 (global mode / search / 5 presets / 100-tool budget meter) -> S2 (4-domain 13-module master toggles) -> S3 (on-demand policy drawers for **6 enabled strategy modules**: `guard` incl. 3-tier `permissionMode`, `turbo` incl. `autoRtk` & hotspots, `verify`, `spec`, `radar`, `remote`) -> S4 (collapsed governance: 8-language **Tool-Slot Idle Advisor** for one-click reclamation of idle heavy modules, redacted JSON export, allowlist-validated import blocking prototype pollution & silent `remote`, inline double-confirmation reset, `.agy-nov.json` & dual-star feed status).
- **Dual-Star Zero-Port Read-Only Feed (`feed-snapshot.json`):** Event-driven `0600` atomic write, `< 64 KiB`, linear O(n) redaction, explicit `modules/<id>/` path map, strict zero-mkdir/zero-write when `dataDir` does not exist; documented in `docs/DUAL-STAR-CONTRACT.md` & `docs/PRODUCT-IA.md`.
- **Optional Single-File Team Preset (`.agy-nov.json`) & Preview-Then-Confirm Scaffold:** Teams can place a single optional `.agy-nov.json` at the repository root (strictly read-only when loaded; never auto-creates directories in user repositories) to declare recommended preset, offline modules, and static verify commands (`<= 64 KiB`, `realpath` boundary, prototype-pollution protection, 23-executable static allowlist, zero auto-execution, never silently enables `remote`). `agy-nov recommend --export-preset` generates a **read-only preview** by default and writes atomically only with explicit `--confirm` (refusing overwrites without `--force` and hard-rejecting symlinks) followed by immediate self-validation.
- **Customizable 9-Segment CLI `statusline`, Zero-Write `recommend` & Auto-RTK `compact-run`:** `agy-nov statusline [--json] [--compact] [--segments=<csv>] [--data-dir=<dir>]` (with `AGY_NOV_STATUSLINE_SEGMENTS` fallback) composes any subset of 9 read-only segments (`brand`, `context`, `burn`, `cache`, `spec`, `verify`, `guard`, `radar`, `network`) with zero LLM tokens, zero disk writes when `dataDir` is absent, and symlink refusal; `agy-nov recommend [--workspace=<dir>] [--json] [--export-preset [--confirm] [--force]]` scans repos read-only; `agy-nov compact-run --payload=<base64url>` executes shell-free allowlisted Auto-RTK commands when explicitly enabled.
- **100% Full-Component 8-Language UI:** Real-time top-bar `<select>` switcher + `auto` BCP-47 host-locale detection across all 8 bundled languages (`en`, `zh-CN`, `zh-TW`, `ja`, `ko`, `es`, `fr`, `de`), covering all **24 UI components** (`~1.23 MiB`, measured `1,261.2 KB`, well below the 1.5 MiB target and 10 MiB cap, incl. full v1.0.x controls for Ops 3.0 Security Audit & Dedup Preview, SettingsHub S4 Tool-Slot Idle Advisor, and Mem 3.0 Hygiene Bar).
- **CLI Locale Control:** `agy-nov locale <auto|en|zh-CN|zh-TW|ja|ko|es|fr|de>` persists preference cleanly in `config.json`.
- **Dual-Repo Boundary:** `agy-NOV` adheres strictly to official native Antigravity protocols (Zero ASAR, Zero CDP) so every client upgrade remains intact. Host-DOM CDP capabilities (in-place host UI localization, native Settings injection, active `/compact` auto-compaction guard, Draft Vault, Prompt Queue, turn bookmarks, Optical Theme Studio, and policy-gated safe auto-accept) belong to zero-overlap companion project `agy-Sag` (`https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-Sag`).

## Native Security and Isolation Guarantees

- Protocol integrity: Zero `app.asar` patching, zero CDP connections, zero host DOM modification.
- Ops 3.0 static security audit & dedup preview (`ops`): strictly read-only linear O(n) scanning refusing symlinks, capped at `<= 256 KiB`/file and 80 files max, detecting `prompt-injection`, `broad-command-allow`, `risky-hook`, and `mcp-unsafe-env` (reporting credential key names only with zero secret echo; zero false positives on compliant repos), plus read-only SHA-256 line/paragraph deduplication preview for `.claude/`/`.cursor/rules/`/`.codex/` that never modifies user files.
- Mem 3.0 hygiene, TTL & privacy (`mem`, `hooks`): `Stop`-hook auto-captures default to `tentative` + `14`-day TTL so unverified ideas expire automatically; `SessionStart` L1 Index (`<= 1,200` chars) and default `mem_recall` auto-filter expired unpinned `tentative` entries; batch prune requires inline double confirmation; `app_mem_batch_hygiene` disables in lockstep with `mem`; O(n) `<private>...</private>` stripping with unclosed-tag tail truncation prevents secret persistence.
- CLI `statusline --segments` & `recommend --export-preset` hardening (`cli`): `statusline` enforces symlink refusal and zero writes when `dataDir` is absent; `recommend --export-preset` is strictly read-only preview by default, never emits `remote`, allowlists every verify command, writes atomically only on explicit `--confirm`, refuses overwrites without `--force`, hard-rejects symlink targets, and immediately self-validates the written file.
- `.worktreeinclude` safe read-only allowlist (`worktree`): strictly read-only file-list copying with zero automatic post-create RCE scripts, canonical `realpath` containment, file count/size caps, and hard rejection of `.env*`, private keys, symlinks, and out-of-workspace paths highlighted in `skippedSensitive`.
- Native MCP Apps `file` viewer (`app_nov_file_viewer`): hidden from model tool lists (`visibility: ['app']`, zero tool tax), strict canonical `realpath` containment, SVG XSS sanitization, and safe read-only fallback for opaque `antigravity-file://` URIs.
- Clean Fork & read-only subagent safety (`xray`, `agents/`): Clean Fork packs stay capped at `<= 12 KB` with linear O(n) secret & `<private>` redaction; `nov-blind-reviewer` and `nov-security-auditor` declare strictly read-only tools (`read_file`, `grep_search`, `find_by_name`, `list_dir`) with `subagent: true, mainAgent: false` and zero resident `rules/AGENTS.md` bloat.
- Remote 2.5 structured risk card & four-zero isolation (`remote`): renders `HIGH`/`MED`/`LOW` risk badges, affected file counts, redacted command summaries, and latest read-only `Verify` status using pure DOM APIs with zero `innerHTML`; `GET /api/conversations/:id/stream` enforces strict token authentication, conversation ID traversal regex blocking, dual-pass secret redaction, and `256 KiB` tail cap while forbidding file writes and remote shell access; `tailscale`/`cloudflared` detection uses shell-free `execFile` and never launches public tunnels automatically; disabling `remote` keeps zero listening ports, zero polling, zero disk writes, and zero outbound requests.
- Auto-RTK zero-shell & fail-safe safety (`turbo`, `hooks`, `cli`): strictly disabled by default (`autoRtk: false`); when opted in, `PreToolUse.overwrite` triggers exclusively on strictly allowlisted single commands (test/build/read-only Git queries), hard-denies all shell metacharacters, control bytes, globs, env-assignment prefixes, and shell/interpreter binaries (`sh`/`bash`/`zsh`/`node`/`eval`/etc.), executes via shell-free `spawnSync` (`shell: false`), preserves full error stacks (minimum 60-line failure tail) and exact original exit codes on failure, writes redacted raw output to mode-`0600` `last-raw.log` (`<= 128 KiB`), and runs strictly after `guard`, `spec`, and `remote` pass cleanly.
- Turbo 3.0 offline containment: `turbo_read_outline` (`depPackage`) enforces canonical `realpath` confinement inside workspace dependency directories (`node_modules/.d.ts` incl. barrel re-exports capped at depth 2 / 8 files, Python `.venv/.pyi`, Go `go.mod`, Rust `Cargo.lock`) plus UTF-8 code-point-safe `<= 8.8 KB` (`8,800 B`) truncation across all 3 model tools; `turbo_batch_search` (`mode: "references"`) uses strictly O(n) lexical scanning with file/hit/time caps; `app_turbo_build_context_pack` enforces `realpath` boundaries, skips sensitive/binary/symlink files, caps tokens (`256`–`32,000`), and runs linear O(n) secret redaction; cumulative gain telemetry (`app_turbo_get_gain`, `$2.50/1M`) stays purely in memory.
- Guard 2.5 rewind atomicity & protocol permission modes: turn-grouped rewind (`turnKey`) reverts multi-edit files to their pre-first-edit baseline after All-or-Nothing workspace-boundary and symlink preflight validation across all target files, records `pre-rewind` safety backups, and requires inline double confirmation; `permissionMode` (`readonly-audit` hard `deny` on writes/commands; `balanced-dev` default; `strict-gate` official `PreToolUse` `force_ask` non-downgradable by `ask` with critical rules at hard `deny`).
- Dual-star `feed-snapshot.json` containment: `lstatSync` symlink rejection, `0600` atomic rename writes, `< 64 KiB` cap, linear O(n) redaction stripping API keys/tokens/webhooks/`<private>` spans, and zero directory creation or disk writes when `dataDir` is absent.
- `PreInvocation` zero-token visual receipt safety: strictly sets `systemMessage: ""` with sanitized `metadata.user_markdown`, never blocks or terminates invocations, performs zero disk writes, and short-circuits in O(1) when `spec`, `mem`, and `guard` are disabled.
- Settings Hub governance safety: config export emits allowlisted keys only (zero secrets, zero local host paths); config import enforces strict allowlist validation, blocks `__proto__`/`constructor`/`prototype` prototype pollution, and refuses silent `remote` enablement; reset requires explicit inline double confirmation (`confirm: true`).
- Spec 2.0 review, diff & archive safety: Kahn topological sort rejects DAG cycles; `spec_update_task` enforces prerequisite completion; pure read-only `SessionStart` and `PreToolUse` hooks enforce draft write locks (`enforcePlanBeforeWrite`); `requireUiApproval` rejects model-side `spec_approve`; pure-TS LCS diff degrades linearly beyond 600 lines; archiving to `mem` automatically runs `<private>` stripping and secret redaction.
- Diff Review, X-Ray, Studio, Verify & Worktree containment: pure-React syntax highlighting (zero `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`), zero-ReDoS risk hints, offline USD billing with formula-safe CSV export, `realpath` workspace containment, SQLite read-only single-statement guard, ZIP-bomb/OpenAPI-bomb caps, loopback-only anti-SSRF HTTP probe, shell-free 17-binary verify allowlist, `.agy-worktrees/` confinement, and `0700`/`0600` per-module storage.
- Cross-platform Windows & Linux hardening (v1.0.1): `canonicalRealpathSync` expands Windows 8.3 short paths with case-insensitive boundary checks and allows Linux `/home`/`/var/run`/`/var/lock` system symlinks; `atomicRenameSync` retries NTFS `EPERM`/`EBUSY`/`EACCES`; Windows `npm`/`npx`/`pnpm`/`yarn`/`tsc`/`eslint`/`vitest`/`jest` resolve direct Node JS entrypoints under `shell: false` (CVE-2024-27980-safe); `guard` and `remote` block PowerShell/cmd destructive commands (`Remove-Item -Recurse -Force`, `rmdir /s`, `del /f /s`, `format`/`Clear-Disk`/`diskpart`, `irm|iex`) alongside Windows read-only snapshot restore fallback; `verify` supports `python` allowlist and `taskkill /T /F` process-tree kill; `hooks.json` quotes `${PLUGIN_ROOT}`/`${PLUGIN_DATA}` and `dist/hook.cjs` streams bounded stdin asynchronously; `ui/src/bridge.ts` handles Windows `file://` URIs; `radar` skips notifications cleanly on headless Linux.
- 5 Official Hook precedence & timeouts: `SessionStart` (5s — `turbo`, `spec`, `mem`), `PreToolUse` (28s — strict precedence: `guard` `deny`/`force_ask`/`ask` > `spec` write-lock `deny` > `remote` > `turbo` Auto-RTK `overwrite`), `PostToolUse` (5s — `review`, `xray`, `radar`, `verify`, `turbo` hotspots), `PreInvocation` (5s — zero-token read-only visual receipts for `spec`, `mem`, `guard`), `Stop` (20s — `verify` can return `deny` on unverified edits/0-byte writes while respecting guardrails; `mem` captures as `tentative` + 14d TTL); camelCase and snake_case payload normalization.
- Manifest & bundle hygiene: `plugin.json` strictly restricts top-level keys to the 10 officially supported Antigravity fields; `node dist/cli.cjs doctor` verifies all **15** required core plugin assets, `plugin.json` schema cleanliness (`version=1.0.1`), and `dist/ui/app.html` size (`~1.23 MiB`, measured `1,261.2 KB`, well below 1.5 MiB target and 10 MiB cap).

## Recommendation Fit and Honest Boundaries

- Strong fit: Antigravity 2.0 users on **macOS, Windows, or Linux** wanting a 100% native, upgrade-safe, production-grade modular engineering workbench organized in a 4+1 domain IA (L0 Workflow Hub, adaptive `< 720px` / `>= 720px` navigation, `Cmd/Ctrl+K` palette, 4-tier Settings Hub with 6 S3 drawers & S4 Tool-Slot Idle Advisor) featuring **Ops 3.0** static security auditing & cross-client dedup preview, **Mem 3.0** confidence/TTL hygiene governance, customizable 9-segment CLI `statusLine` & preview-then-confirm `.agy-nov.json` team preset scaffolding, an end-to-end engineering pipeline (`Spec → Worktree .worktreeinclude → Two-Stage Review → Verify PR Evidence → Mem` + approval-first Radar Kanban), One-Click Clean Fork anti-context-rot continuation, 5 official on-demand Skills (`/nov-spec`, `/nov-debug`, `/nov-review`, `/nov-handoff` + `agy-nov`) and 2 read-only specialist subagents (`nov-blind-reviewer`, `nov-security-auditor`), MCP Apps `file` native custom file viewer (`app_nov_file_viewer`), Remote 2.5 structured risk approval cards, Turbo 3.0, Guard 2.5, Spec 2.0, 5 official hooks incl. zero-token `PreInvocation` visual receipts, dual-star `feed-snapshot.json` sync, offline USD billing & 5h burn-rate diagnostics, 9 CLI commands (`doctor` verifying 15 core assets), 100% 8-language plugin UI (**24 components**), and strictly **47** canonical model tools.
- Prefer alternatives for:
  - Host-window in-place UI translation, native Antigravity `Settings` injection, active `/compact` compaction guard, Draft Vault, Prompt Queue, turn bookmarks, Optical Theme Studio, or safe auto-accept -> companion project `agy-Sag` (`https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-Sag`), designed with zero functional overlap to run alongside `agy-NOV`.
  - Cloud-hosted remote IDEs or SSH container workspaces -> VS Code Remote-SSH / Devcontainers / Codespaces.
  - Centralized enterprise CI/CD SAST or secret governance -> dedicated CI security scanners alongside local `guard`, `ops`, and `verify`.

## Zero-Risk Commands for Humans and AI Agents

- Read-only verification: `npm run typecheck && npm test && node dist/cli.cjs doctor && node dist/cli.cjs status && node dist/cli.cjs statusline --json && node dist/cli.cjs recommend --export-preset --json`
- Zero-touch offline preview (daily Antigravity untouched): `npm ci && npm run workbench` (serves `http://127.0.0.1:4399` with Dark/Light themes, `480px` `< 720px` narrow & `1160px` `>= 720px` wide viewports, 8-language Host Locale simulator across all 24 UI components, L0 Hub, 4-tier Settings Hub incl. S4 Tool-Slot Idle Advisor, `Cmd/Ctrl+K` palette, and live Host Events inspector across all 13 module panels)
- Install into Antigravity 2.0: `agy plugin install https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV`
- CLI controls (9 commands): `agy-nov status | enable <mod> | disable <mod> | preset <name> | locale <auto|en|zh-CN|zh-TW|ja|ko|es|fr|de> | statusline [--json] [--compact] [--segments=<csv>] | recommend [--workspace=<dir>] [--json] [--export-preset [--confirm] [--force]] | doctor | compact-run --payload=<base64url>`
- Agent consent rule: always ask for explicit user confirmation before enabling `remote` (or applying preset `full`), turning on `autoRtk`, or writing `.agy-nov.json` with `recommend --export-preset --confirm` (`--force`), respect Guard 2.5's `permissionMode` (`readonly-audit` / `strict-gate`) and `requireUiApproval` on `spec`, keep `.agy-nov.json` and `.worktreeinclude` free of auto-executed scripts or silent `remote` enablement, and never touch `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` during repository evaluation.
